preserved_terms: Exact bounded result and validation values
contract.remaining_blocker: Missing durable T02 materialization/ledger/source enrollment and historical replay operand integration, not inability to serialize typed Snapshot members
contract.revised_requirement: Remove mandatory inline validation_instances/source_additions in the A04 event payload. Require native typed values and source pins to be atomically admitted and immutably correlated through event/result/dossier/post-Snapshot/bundle/parent/ledger.
superseded_terms: Old required-event-operands as a mandatory serialized event.result shape
Event identity unavailability solely because validation values are not inline
Missing validation-reference field alone as an execution blocker

generic_capability.durable_contract: Atomically publish complete native event/result/output/dossier/validation state/source pins/post-bundle under the trusted current HEAD. No partial accepted occurrence or validation set can be exposed as P05 occurrence evidence.
failure_atomicity: No successful event with missing/failed/misbound validation
No completed PREPARE/knowledge/dossier without its required occurrence event
No validation tuple treated as proof of occurrence on its own
No head advancement or partial provenance on failure
generic_capability.idempotence: Same admitted semantic operation must preserve exactly one event/state effect; conflicting result/tuple/content or stale parent fails closed. Existing state-level T02 no-op does not establish durable exactly-once behavior.
generic_capability.identity_contract: Native event identity binds supported full result plus immutable before/after Snapshot identities and parent/sequence. Exact ValidationInstance values must be reachable under after_snapshot and subject/input native bindings.
generic_capability.preflight_execution_equivalence: Same canonical result, tuple and source content validated and consumed; no substitution between stages.
generic_capability.replay_operand_contract: Retain all original typed evaluation outcomes in a deterministically recoverable native representation for each historical materialization. Resolve content by immutable native identity, verify subject/parent/pre-state/input/source, and reproduce exact T02 state effects. Never use latest mutable state or writer memory as historical operand.
required_qualification: Complete native operation/replay representation contract before implementation
Failure injection before native HEAD publication
Cold readers/replay from exact retained start
Historical detached operand retention if chosen
semantic_input_contract: Six independently evaluated typed ValidationInstances with exact subject/input/source/currentness
Sealed raw source additions and provenance
generic_capability.serialization_constraint: An inline typed materialization operand is one possible future implementation; a lossless native detached/reference operand is another only with an explicit codec/archive resolver contract. Neither is currently registered for A04. No storage layout is invented or implemented here.
generic_capability.source_contract: Bind new raw source pins at the same historical event boundary, preserve exact prefix-source inventory, and verify ValidationInstance/dossier provenance on cold restore/replay.
generic_capability.unchanged_semantics: Invoke existing T02 admission for selected decision-input Action; no validation Boolean, new authority, human choice or extra Action execution.

N12_MAPPING.composite: Require actual supplied result + native admitted event + enrolled parent/ledger + complete typed post-state; selection alone has none of these

N13_MAPPING.composite: Require fresh actual producer result and independently evaluated validations admitted in the native transaction; declaration/oracle/snapshot alone cannot establish occurrence
N13_MAPPING.original: Output declaration is not an actual result

NATIVE_CORRELATION.B_dedicated_validation_object_refs_alrea: NO; no standalone ValidationInstance ID or validation-ref field
NATIVE_CORRELATION.B_transitive_snapshot_reference_already_: YES; after_snapshot binds all typed Snapshot members
NATIVE_CORRELATION.D_exact_native_composite_representation: YES; existing types suffice for value/hash representation, not current operation/replay admission
NATIVE_CORRELATION.bundle_and_HEAD: Trusted post-bundle identity binds initial/events/current/source index/policy. Native HEAD.previous binds exact prior bundle; enrollment/sequence/parent links required separately.
NATIVE_CORRELATION.event_result: event.result is full SuppliedResult; Action/outcome/knowledge/dossier are inside its native canonical body
NATIVE_CORRELATION.generation_scope_lineage: Verify immutable pre/post Snapshot.context and each validation scope/lineage; source/provenance binds same experiment.
NATIVE_CORRELATION.lossless_membership: Given verified post-Snapshot bytes, every ValidationInstance field is retained and recoverable; it is not inferred from readiness or status.
NATIVE_CORRELATION.native_command_id: NONE for ordinary SuppliedResult; HEAD.command=None. No required command identity is invented.
NATIVE_CORRELATION.post_state_members: Hash exact PLANNER-SNAPSHOT-1 bytes, then select unique typed members by PredicateId; each must bind the same dossier/body and exact input state/source.
NATIVE_CORRELATION.representation: ExecutionEvent + inline SuppliedResult/dossier + immutable post-Snapshot ValidationInstances + source-pinned PersistenceBundle
NATIVE_CORRELATION.support_provenance: Keep complete typed record provenance and exact raw source pins; an unchecked path or a report label is insufficient.

NATIVE_EVENT_SCHEMA.envelope_role: Existing native ExecutionEvent; no dedicated historical PREPARE tag
NATIVE_EVENT_SCHEMA.existing_transitive_reference: after_snapshot -> complete immutable Snapshot, including validation_instances

fields.type: typing.Union[adapter.planner.model.SuppliedResult, adapter.planner.model.RecordedDecision, adapter.planner.model.DecisionReentry, adapter.planner.model.ExternalEvent, adapter.planner.model.SourceInvalidation, adapter.planner.model.EvidenceSourceAdmission, adapter.planner.model.TypedProofAdmission, adapter.planner.model.ProofDependencyChange, adapter.planner.model.ActionReevaluation, adapter.planner.model.InstallDefinition, adapter.planner.model.ValidationSupportAdmission]

NATIVE_RESULT_SCHEMA.decision_checks: DecisionDossier.checks stores typed check metadata/PredicateId references, not the evaluated outcomes
NATIVE_RESULT_SCHEMA.direct_event_reference: ExecutionEvent.result stores the full typed SuppliedResult value, not a separate result ID
NATIVE_RESULT_SCHEMA.dossier_validation_flag: Dossier currentness only; cannot substitute for the six independently evaluated records
NATIVE_RESULT_SCHEMA.result_meaning: Actual bounded producer outcome/knowledge and optional prepared dossier
NATIVE_RESULT_SCHEMA.validations: ValidationInstances are a separate T02 argument; not fields of SuppliedResult or DecisionDossier

NATIVE_VALIDATION_REPRESENTATION.immutable_member_binding: (event.after_snapshot, ValidationInstance.predicate, ValidationInstance.dossier) plus full canonical native member value
NATIVE_VALIDATION_REPRESENTATION.record_currentness: Persisted ValidationOutcome/currentness/provenance, subject to native invalidation
NATIVE_VALIDATION_REPRESENTATION.restore_validation_outcome: Retain original typed evaluation result; do not replace with a new independent validation decision
NATIVE_VALIDATION_REPRESENTATION.unique_native_selector: PredicateId is unique within a Snapshot; dossier ArtifactIdentity must also match

P05_input.EXPECTED_PROVENANCE: Exact authoritative native records/source pins and owning result, ordinary event ancestry for lifecycle occurrence; no qualification-instance substitution
P05_input.EXPECTED_VALUE_RESULT: Human decision becomes ready only with complete dossier/checks; authority requirement alone did not make it ready

P05_ANCESTRY_ASSURANCE.historical_scope: Original A04 ancestry remains UNPROVEN. A future admitted composite may close only the authorized prospective A04 replacement term.
P05_ANCESTRY_ASSURANCE.old_24_negative_controls: Unchanged; event payload tampering means actual supported payload/reference/body association tampering, not absence of a nonexistent inline field

terms.minimum_witness: Actual native ExecutionEvent, enrolled once in the exact continued ledger
parent_event and parent_snapshot; result.expected_snapshot; enrolled predecessor continuity
sequence3/index2 and exact CHECK->COLLECT->PREPARE membership; root/head
Six exact typed Snapshot records linked by after_snapshot and dossier/predicate/input binding
Exact E2-K-PREPARE in actual result and post-Snapshot knowledge; producer/provenance equality
terms.native_location: Inline result plus separate typed KnowledgeRecord state

terms.minimum_witness: after_snapshot equals recomputed/verified canonical native Snapshot identity
terms.native_location: Event identity reference + full native Snapshot

terms.minimum_witness: Exact record values and source pins, with source enrollment at same semantic transaction
DECISION_READY/HUMAN_HANDOFF recomputed over admitted typed inputs

REPLAY_CORRELATION: PersistenceBundle retains initial/events/current, not a separately addressable after-Snapshot object per event. Event.after_snapshot is a hash, not an object lookup implementation. Current _replay requires apply_event to regenerate each exact after_snapshot.

TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.A04_integration_gap: No event dispatcher calls T02 with its validation tuple. SuppliedResult has no such operand. Current replay reads only event.result, not post/current state as historical operand.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.HEAD_correlation_gap: Existing SuppliedResult HEAD.command=None and _prefix_bundle replays only supported event results; a report transaction ID cannot supply missing historical operands.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.T02_report_limit: T02 runtime_transaction.atomic=true and encode_decode replay PASS refer to state materialization/typed Snapshot retention. No append-only parallel store is claimed; this does not establish complete event-bearing transaction replay.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.durable_visibility: Canonical transaction is published at trusted HEAD, not at first immutable file write; crash-created orphan files do not establish acceptance
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.existing_durable_boundary: codec.commit_event takes trusted current head under local lock, record_result/apply_event computes post-state, save_bundle validates/replays and writes immutable event/bundle artifacts, then _publish_head atomically replaces HEAD
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.ordinary_path_fails_for_sealed_start: Action.prepared_dossier=None; ordinary validate_result compares supplied dossier with None. It also cannot introduce independent typed instances through the result field.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.other_native_validation_transaction: ValidationSupportAdmission is specialized to Evidence/receipt/validation-contract/support A10. It has typed outcomes and command identity but does not implement dossier/check admission; reuse as A04 would change semantics.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.replay_gap: PersistenceBundle retains initial/events/current, not a separately addressable after-Snapshot object per event. Event.after_snapshot is a hash, not an object lookup implementation. Current _replay requires apply_event to regenerate each exact after_snapshot.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.source_gap: Sealed new dossier source is offline. Per-event source-addition/prefix/retry handling recognizes other typed admissions, not T02 materialization.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY.state_atomicity_supported: T02 returns one immutable TransitionReport only after accepted result/dossier/six checks; failure has no partial returned state
